t: Bosch GSB 18V-55 brushless combi drill delivers heavy-duty drilling and screwdriving power for demanding construction tasks. The cordless tool is designed for carpenters, electricians, and plumbers working on site. High-performance brushless motor technology ensures extended tool life and maximum runtime. Features 21 torque settings plus drill and hammer drill functions, offering precise control when working with wood, metal, or masonry. Delivers drilling capacities of up to 35mm in wood and 13mm in steel or masonry, supported by rapid 27,000bpm impact rate. Equipped with a tough 13mm all-metal Roehm keyless chuck for secure bit retention and reliable power transfer during heavy-duty applications. An integrated LED work light illuminates dark work areas for improved visibility. Supplied with 2 x 5.0Ah Li-ion batteries, quick charger, and L-Case.
